args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays. Affects fastjson <2.9.4 in the 2.x line; fixed in 2.9.4.
Staying on the 2.x line for a minimal, compatible patch upgrade.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

## Details
- Affected range: fastjson <2.9.4 (2.x line)
- Fix: 2.9.4 — the minimal patch upgrade within the 2.x line, avoiding the major-version jump to 3.x
- Change is limited to `requirements.txt` (`fastjson==2.9.4`)

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch: **passed** ✅

@alex — requesting your review as code owner. Merging into main requires code-owner approval per policy.
